summary: 3 high-impact releases: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Tue), ISM Services PMI (Thu), Non-farm payrolls (Fri). The next Fed decision is Dec 8–9, 12 days from today.

days.t: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Nov) at 10:00 NY (previous 55.5, forecast 55.2). Factory activity is one of the first readings of each month. JOLTS job openings (Oct) at 10:00 NY (previous 7.52M, forecast 7.5M).
ADP private payrolls (Nov) at 08:15 NY (previous 86K, forecast 82K).

Initial jobless claims at 08:30 NY (previous 189K, forecast 195K). ISM Services PMI (Nov) at 10:00 NY (previous 54.5, forecast 54.5). Services make up most of the US economy, and its prices index tracks sticky inflation.

Non-farm payrolls · Employment situation (Nov) at 08:30 NY (previous 165K, forecast 93K). Jobs and wages are half of the Fed's mandate, and payrolls are often the most volatile release of the month. UMich consumer sentiment, preliminary (Dec) at 10:00 NY (previous 48.0, forecast 51.8).
